title: Semi-structured data: nested records and arrays
objectives: Reach into nested fields with dot paths
Turn an array into one row per element
Compare Snowflake's VARIANT and FLATTEN with Fabric and Spark

exercises.prompt: Each event's payload holds a customer and an array of items. Return one row per item: event_id, customer_id, sku and qty, in event_id then sku order.
hints: payload.customer.id reaches the customer's id. The items are an array: one event row holds several.
unnest(payload.items) AS item gives one row per item; then item.sku and item.qty.
